    StartersThumper's clover salad cupsBaby cos cups with pea shoots, mint and shaved parmesanHow to make it2 baby cos lettuces1 punnet pea shoots1/4 cup mint leaves1 tbsp lemon juice1 tbsp olive oil30g parmesan, shaved3 tbsp pepitas, toastedSeparate the cos into small cups.Toss the pea shoots and mint with lemon juice and olive oil.Spoon into each cup and top with parmesan and pepitas.Flower's garden cruditésWhipped feta and yoghurt dip with carrots, radishes and snow peasHow to make it200g feta200g Greek yoghurt1 tbsp honey1 tbsp chopped dill1 bag baby carrots1 bunch radishes150g snow peasWhip the feta with yoghurt, honey and dill until smooth.Spread in a shallow dish.Arrange carrots, radishes and snow peas around it like a garden bed and serve chilled.Spring greens and ricotta tartAwful stuff to eat, Thumper says. He made that bit up.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsGreat Prince's woodland mushroom pieCreamy mushroom and leek pie under puff pastryHow to make it600g mixed mushrooms, sliced1 leek, sliced60g butter4 thyme sprigs200ml cream2 sheets of puff pastry1 tbsp milkCook the mushrooms and leek in butter with thyme until soft and golden.Add the cream and simmer until thick.Spoon into a pie dish, top with puff pastry and brush with milk.Bake at 200°C until golden.First snow roast pumpkin soupBambi seeing snow for the first timeHow to make itAs written, serves 4Roasted pumpkin and carrot blended silky with stock, cream and nutmeg, served with a snowy swirl of cream and crunchy garlic toasts.Toss 1.2kg pumpkin chunks, 2 chopped carrots and 1 quartered onion with oil and salt and roast at 200°C for 35 minutes.Blend with 1L chicken or vegetable stock until smooth, then reheat with 100ml cream and a pinch of nutmeg and season.Slice a baguette, brush with oil, rub with garlic and toast at 200°C for 8 minutes.Serve the soup with a swirl of cream and the toasts.SweetsFrozen pond pavlovaMeringue pond, cream and berries, for Bambi's slip on the iceHow to make it4 egg whites220g caster sugar1 tsp cornflour300ml thickened cream, whipped125g raspberries125g blueberriesWhisk the egg whites to stiff peaks.Add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy, then fold in the cornflour.Spread into a flat round like a frozen pond.Bake at 120°C, then cool in the oven.Top with whipped cream, raspberries and blueberries.Forest berry custard tartletsBerry custard, sweet as Flower the skunkHow to make itAs written, serves 4Crisp little shortcrust cases filled with vanilla custard and piled with strawberries, blueberries and raspberries, dusted with icing sugar.Cut 12 rounds from 2 shortcrust sheets and press into a muffin tin.Prick and bake at 180°C for 12 minutes until golden, then cool.Heat 300ml milk with 1 tsp vanilla.Whisk 3 egg yolks, 60g sugar and 2 tbsp cornflour, pour in the hot milk, return to the pan and stir until thick.Cool, then spoon into the cases and top with 250g mixed berries.Dust with icing sugar.DrinksSpring meadow coolerApple
